name: Dreiseenhütte
kurzbeschreibung: Three Lakes Hut in Tirol Nestled in the heart of the Zillertal Alps, the Dreiseenhütte is a true paradise for hikers and nature lovers.
beschreibung: The Dreiseenhütte in Imst spoils its guests with a fine selection of regional and seasonal alpine specialties. The kitchen artfully brings together classic Tyrolean recipes and creative touches, offering a unique taste of the mountains. The rustic, welcoming interior invites visitors to rest and recharge, while courteous staff ensure their well-being. A warm bowl of homemade Tyrolean dumpling soup is especially revitalizing after a long day of alpine hiking. In addition, the hut offers a curated wine list with select vintages from South Tyrol and Austria.
